risks: Very large unpaginated lists can exceed SQLite's bound-parameter limit in the IN clause.
Listing still returns every note; memory and payload size grow linearly.
trade_offs: Kept the response unpaginated to honour 'no API changes', leaving the biggest win (pagination) on the table.
Two extra indexes slightly slow writes to note_tags in exchange for fast reads.
failure_scenarios: A note table beyond ~32k rows makes the IN list fail on older SQLite builds; chunking the id list is the fix.
guardrails: Regression test fails if per-note queries return.
Existing behaviour tests (tag filter, order) still pass.
